definitions.explanation: Two years from the current year.

examples.japanese: {再来年|さらいねん}、⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll graduate from university the year after next.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再来年|さらいねん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The Olympics are the year after next.

examples.japanese: {再来年|さらいねん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become good at Japanese by the year after next.

examples.japanese: {再来年|さらいねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{考|かんが}えても→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Even if I think about it now, I don't know what will happen the year after next.

examples.japanese: {再来年|さらいねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てて→建てる：01189_tateru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住|す}みたい→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: The year after next, I want to build a new house and live there with my whole family.

notes:
{再来年|さらいねん} means "the year after next" - two years from the current year.

TIME REFERENCE SEQUENCE:
- {一昨年|おととし}/{一昨年|いっさくねん}: year before last
- {去年|きょねん}/{昨年|さくねん}: last year
- {今年|ことし}: this year
- {来年|らいねん}: next year
- {再来年|さらいねん}: year after next

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {再来月|さらいげつ}: month after next
- {再来週|さらいしゅう}: week after next

NOTE:
{昨年|さくねん} is more formal than {去年|きょねん}, often used in writing and formal speech. Similarly, {一昨年|いっさくねん} is more formal than {一昨年|おととし}.
